header: Title: Wavy Pot Holder | US terms
text:
Wavy Pot Holder
US terms.
Abbreviations: sc = single crochet, inc = 2 sc in the same st, dec = sc2tog.
Foundation: ch 26
R1. Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each ch across [25]
R2. Ch1, turn, 2sc, 3hdc, 15tr, 3hdc, 2sc [25]
R3. Ch1, turn, sc in each st across [25]
R4. Ch 1, turn, 3sc, 1hdc, 17dc, 1hdc, 3sc [25]
R5. Ch1, turn, sc in each st across [25]
R6. Ch1, turn, 3sc, 2hdc, 15dc, 2hdc, 3sc [25]
R7-8. Ch1, turn, sc in each st across [25]
Fasten off and weave in ends.

header: Title: Striped Sleeve | US terms | worked in joined rounds
text:
Striped Sleeve
US terms. Each round is worked in joined rounds: join with a sl st to the first st.
R1. 7 sc in MR, join with sl st to first sc (7).
R2. Ch 1, increase 7 times, join with sl st to first sc (14).
R3. Ch 1, (sc, increase) 7 times, join with a sl st (21).
R4. Ch 1, (sc 2, increase) 7 times, sl st to join (28).
R5-6. Ch 1, sc in each st around, join with sl st to first sc (28).
Change to color B.
R7-8. Ch 1, sc 28, join with a sl st (28).
Fasten off. Do not stuff.

header: Title: Lucky Chick | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Lucky Chick
US crochet terms used throughout.
Worked in spiral rounds, use a stitch marker.
Head (make 1)
R1: MR, 5 sc (5)
R2: *increase; rep from * around (10)
R3: *sc in next st, increase; rep from * around (15)
R4: Sc in next st, increase, (sc in next 2 sts, increase) x4, sc in next st (20)
R5: Sc in next st, increase, (sc in next 3 sts, increase) x4, sc in next 2 sts (25)
R6-R7: Sc around (25)
R8: Sc around
R9: (sc in next 3 sts, sc dec) x5 (20)
R10: *sc in next 2 sts, sc dec; rep from * around (15)
FO, leave a tail.
Arms (make 2):
R1: MR, 5 sc (5)
R2: Increase x5 (10)
R3: Sc around (10)

header: Title: Sleepy Pebble | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Sleepy Pebble
Written in US terms.
Worked in continuous spiral rounds.
Rnd 1: 7 sc in magic ring (7 sc).
Rnd 2: Repeat increase seven times (14 sc).
Rnd 3: Repeat (1sc, increase) seven times (21 sc).
Rnd 4: Repeat (2sc, increase) seven times (28 sc).
Rnd 5: Repeat (3sc, increase) seven times (35 sc).
Rnd 6: Sc around (35 sc).
Rnd 7: Sc around (35 sc).
Rnds 8-11: 35sc (35 sc).
Rnd 12: Sc in BLO around (35 sc).
Place safety eyes between Rnd 6 and 7, about 7 sts apart.
Rnd 13: (3sc, dec) around (28 sc).
Begin stuffing.
Rnd 14: Repeat (2sc, dec) eight times (21 sc).
Rnd 15: Repeat (1sc, dec) seven times (14 sc).
Rnd 16: Repeat dec seven times (7 sc).
FO, leave a long tail.

header: Title: Speckled Candle | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Speckled Candle
Written in US terms. Worked in continuous spiral rounds.
Materials: aran yarn in two colors, 5 mm hook, 9 mm safety eyes, fiberfill.
RND 1: MR, 8 sc (8 sts)
RND 2: *inc* 8 times (16 sts)
Work the next round in BLO.
RND 3: Sc in each st around (16 sts)
RNDS 4-12: Sc in each st around (16 sts)
RND 13: Sc in each st around (16 sts)
Fasten off. Do not stuff.

header: Title: Soft Washcloth | US terms | worked in rows
text:
Soft Washcloth
Written in US terms.
Worked in rows, turning at the end of each row.
Materials: worsted weight cotton, 5 mm hook, tapestry needle.
Chain 25.
Row 1: Hdc in 3rd ch from hook (skipped chains count as first hdc) and in each ch across - 26 stitches
Rows 2-3: Ch 2 (counts as hdc), turn, hdc in each st across - 26 stitches
Rows 4-8: Ch 2 (counts as hdc), turn, hdc in next st and in each st across - 26 stitches
Row 9: Ch 2 (counts as 1 hdc throughout), turn, skip first st, hdc in each st across - 26 stitches
Fasten off and weave in ends.

header: Title: Tiny Head | worked in joined rounds
text:
Tiny Head
US crochet terms used throughout. Worked in joined rounds.
You will need: DK cotton yarn, 3.5 mm hook, scissors.
R1. 5 single crochets in a magic ring, join with a slip stitch – 5 stitches
R2. Chain 1, make 2 single crochets in each of the next 5 stitches, join with a slip stitch to the first single crochet – 10 stitches
R3. Chain 1, (single crochet in the next 2 stitches, 2 single crochets in the next stitch) all the way around, join – 15 stitches
R4. Chain 1, *single crochet in the next 2 stitches, 2 single crochets in the next stitch; repeat from * around, join with a slip stitch – 20 stitches
R5. Chain 1, (single crochet in the next 3 stitches, 2 single crochets in the next stitch) repeated 5 times, join with a slip stitch – 25 stitches
R6. Chain 1, (single crochet in the next 4 stitches, 2 single crochets in the next stitch) repeated 5 times, join with a slip stitch – 30 stitches
R7. Chain 1, single crochet in the next 30 stitches, join with a slip stitch –
R8-9. Chain 1, single crochet in each stitch around, join with a slip stitch to the first single crochet – 30 stitches
R10-11. Chain 1, single crochet in the next 30 stitches, join with a slip stitch to the first single crochet – 30 stitches
R12. Chain 1, single crochet in each stitch around, join with a slip stitch – 30 stitches
R13. Chain 1, (single crochet in the next 4 stitches, invisible decrease) all the way around, slip stitch to join – 25 stitches
Start stuffing, adding more as you go.
R14. Chain 1, (single crochet in the next 3 stitches, invisible decrease) repeated 5 times, join – 20 stitches
R15. Chain 1, (single crochet in the next 2 stitches, invisible decrease) repeated 5 times, join with a slip stitch – 15 stitches
R16. Chain 1, (single crochet in the next stitch, invisible decrease) all the way around, join with a slip stitch to the first single crochet – 10 stitches
R17. Chain 1, invisible decrease all around, join with a slip stitch – 5 stitches
Fasten off and weave in ends.
